items.title: Kemi Badenoch told 'I would have shot you dead' by man claiming to be ex-IRA
items.description: A man has admitted sending Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch threatening emails, including one in which he said "when I was in the IRA I would have shot you f****** dead".

items.title: Rape and sexual offences to be dealt with in specialist courts
items.description: Specialist courts to deal with rape and sexual offences are to be introduced across England and Wales, the prime minister has said.

items.description: A national taskforce aimed at tackling misogyny across society has been launched by the government.
